newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Unisource wins Virgin Express order.
newsitem.headline: Unisource wins Virgin Express order.

text.p: European telecoms joint venture Unisource NV said on Thursday it had won a "multi-million dollar" long term contract from Virgin Express, the European airline owned by Richard Branson.
The contract, awarded to Unisource Belgium, is for a call centre services offered via the AT&T Unisource venture, which is 60/40 held by Unisource and U.S. phone giant AT&T.
The AT&T-Unisource Call Centre Service will cover Denmark, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, Sweden and the United Kingdom, a Unisource statement said.
Unisource is a telecoms joint venture grouping Dutch PTT, Telia of Sweden and Swiss Telecom PTT.
